entries.en: profit or interest on a loan; to lend money at interest (reckoning the interest money).

entries.zh: 本息合并核算（连本带利一起算）；放债时合计本息。
entries.en: to reckon money together with its interest; to compute compound interest on a loan.
entries.notes: 『合』作合计、连合解，系据 M 栏 hâp 与 H 栏推得，L 栏仅重出 logro dar a logro。

entries.en: to lend money at interest; to practise usury.
entries.notes: H 栏『放債』义明，惟 M 栏 che、lay 两处 T99 漫漶，且『L pâng lay』为缩写记音。

entries.zh: 只取利钱而不动本金的放贷；本金分文不减而生利。
entries.en: interest taken without any part of the principal being given up.
entries.notes: L 栏『sin per dar』疑为『sin perder』之讹；H 栏『叩算』疑即『扣算』。

entries.zh: 欠债不还时所附加的利钱（逾期追讨之息）。
entries.en: interest charged on a debt that is not paid; interest accruing on arrears.
entries.notes: L 栏缺损（[疑:cobrala/sobre la]），H 栏『車算』形义不合，疑为『賒算』之讹。

entries.zh: 不滚利的利钱（单利）；利不生利。
entries.en: interest that does not multiply; simple interest.
entries.notes: M 栏作『無利錢』(bô lī tsînn)，H 栏脱『無』字，据 L 栏 no multiplica 定为止息不生利。

entries.en: interest; interest that breeds no further interest.
entries.notes: M 栏后半『noaigan ana cia』漫漶难辨（T99），疑为西语 no hay ganancia 之记音。

entries.en: intestinal worm; roundworm (lombriz de las tripas).
entries.notes: H 栏『面虫』与西语『肠中之虫』不合，疑字形有误或为方言别称，第三音节 T99 漫漶。

entries.en: loins; the meat along an animal's back.
entries.notes: H 栏〔疑:脢/膂〕；R 栏『chham loc.』不合官话对音，疑旁注窜入。

entries.en: loin meat; flesh of the back.
entries.notes: H 栏〔疑:脢/膂〕，M 栏 būe bâ 与『脢肉』相应，取脢字。

entries.zh: 灌肉入猪肠（制香肠）；香肠。
entries.en: sausage; meat stuffed into a pig's casing (longaniza).

entries.zh: 任凭他们想怎么做；尚待裁夺。
entries.en: whatever they may wish to do; still to be settled.
entries.notes: L 栏为整句套语，H 栏『尚裁』与『随其所欲』不完全对应，姑以尚待裁夺取义。
L 栏尾『à [ploser/plorar]』与 losa 不合，疑窜入；H 栏〔疑:板/枚〕，M 栏 chiŏ păn 支持石板。
